source.inline:
if application "Spotify" is running then
	tell application "Spotify"
		if player state is playing then
			return "  " & name of current track & " - " & artist of current track
		else
			return "  ⏸ Paused."
		end if
	end tell
else
	return "  Open Spotify to continue playing."
end if

actionAppleScript.inline:
if application "Spotify" is running then
	tell application "Spotify" to playpause
else
	tell application "Spotify" to activate
end if

source.inline:
set battStatus to do shell script "pmset -g batt"
set timeStr to do shell script "echo " & quoted form of battStatus & " | grep -Eo '[0-9]+:[0-9]+' | head -n 1 || true"
set outTitle to ""

if battStatus contains "discharging" then
	if timeStr is not "" then
		set {oldTID, AppleScript's text item delimiters} to {AppleScript's text item delimiters, ":"}
		set h to text item 1 of timeStr
		set m to text item 2 of timeStr
		set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldTID
		if length of h is 1 then set h to "0" & h
		set outTitle to h & ":" & m & " left."
	else
		set outTitle to "Calculating..."
	end if
else if battStatus contains "charging" then
	if timeStr is not "" then
		set {oldTID, AppleScript's text item delimiters} to {AppleScript's text item delimiters, ":"}
		set h to text item 1 of timeStr
		set m to text item 2 of timeStr
		set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldTID
		if length of h is 1 then set h to "0" & h
		set outTitle to h & ":" & m & " until full."
	else
		set outTitle to "Calculating..."
	end if
else if battStatus contains "charged" then
	set outTitle to "Fully charged."
end if

return "  " & outTitle

sourceApple.inline: if application "Spotify" is running then tell application "Spotify" to set player position to (player position + 15)
if application "Spotify" is running then tell application "Spotify" to set player position to (player position - 15)
